summary: Grupo Aeromexico filed a 6-K furnishing a September 18, 2026 press release responding to a request from Mexico's CNBV regarding unusual trading movements in its BMV/NYSE-listed (AERO) shares under Article 106 of the Mexican Securities Market Law and Article 50 of the issuer regulations. The company states it is unaware of any cause beyond publicly available information, including notice of a forthcoming General Shareholders Meeting, and that no board members or relevant officers participated. No terms, stake, price, advisor, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is a routine market-monitoring disclosure, not a special situation; watch for the meeting agenda and any subsequent price volatility.
